title: The CR's own examples, chapter 9 (Abilities)
blind: Written from the CR text, printed card text and rulings (the lookup skill, with the modelled abilities filtered out of its card view) only. The engine's code, its tests for these examples and their baselines were not read. Committed before the comparison for this batch existed. This session had read the shared harness and driving helpers, and the hand-over note's list of things earlier reader sessions saw of the engine (Corroder's pump offered only in an encounter, traces resolving with no spending, Hostile Infrastructure firing once for a simultaneous trash, and the rest); nothing here leans on them. While finding the plan rows to read, a search also printed two rows of the plan's findings table (Invasion of Privacy; a flatline on the seventh point and Ayla's setup); neither bears on a chapter 9 example.
defaults: Unless a case says otherwise: the Runner has the default 4 MU and no link, both identities are blank, servers have no ice, the Corp has 5 credits and the Runner 5, the Runner has 4 clicks and the Corp 3 at the start of their turn, zones not mentioned hold only cards with no relevant abilities, neither player spends credits on a trace, the Runner trashes no accessed card, and the Corp declines to rez or use anything not listed in the steps. 'accessed' lists every card accessed during the steps, in order, across breaches.

cases.position: Runner's turn. The Runner's identity is Armand "Geist" Walker. Decoy is installed. The grip holds exactly 2 cards and the stack holds at least 1. Snare! is the top card of R&D, which has no ice. The Corp has 5 credits.

steps.label: snare
steps.do: The Runner runs R&D and accesses Snare!. The Corp pays 4 credits. Before the tag is taken the Runner trashes Decoy to prevent it. Everything then resolves.

expect.why: Not a standard key: who has won the game. Geist's draw resolves before the damage, so 3 net damage meets 3 cards and the Runner survives.
Decoy prevented the 1 tag.
2 cards, plus 1 drawn for using Decoy's trash ability, minus 3 for the net damage.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Global Food Initiative is in the Corp's score area (3 agenda points), so Attini's threat 3 ability is active. A rezzed Attini is the only ice protecting HQ. The Runner has Caldera installed, 10 credits, 4 cards in the grip and no icebreaker.

steps.label: subs
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Attini and breaks nothing. For each subroutine the Runner tries to pay 2 credits, and tries to use Caldera to prevent the net damage. All three subroutines resolve.

expect.why: The Runner cannot spend credits while a subroutine on Attini is resolving.
The interrupt window for the damage is part of the subroutine resolving, so Caldera's 3 credits cannot be spent.
Three subroutines, 1 net damage each.

cases.position: As 9.1.2b.ex1, but no player has any agenda points, so Attini's threat 3 ability is not active.

steps.label: subs
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Attini and breaks nothing. For each subroutine the Runner pays 2 credits.

expect.why: Without the threat ability nothing stops the Runner spending credits.

cases.position: Runner's turn. The Runner's identity is Zahya Sadeghi: Versatile Smuggler. Direct Access is in the grip. HQ has no ice and holds exactly one card, Hedge Fund. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: direct
steps.do: The Runner plays Direct Access, runs HQ and accesses Hedge Fund. The run ends. The Runner does not shuffle Direct Access into the stack.

steps.label: second
steps.do: The Runner takes the basic action to run HQ, accesses Hedge Fund, and when the run ends uses Zahya Sadeghi's ability.

expect.why: The reaction window after the run is still part of Direct Access resolving, and Direct Access removes the identity's ability while it resolves.
5, less 1 to play Direct Access. No credit from Zahya.
Direct Access has finished resolving and the once per turn ability has not been used.
1 credit for the one card accessed.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Compile is in the grip and Mayfly is in the stack. A rezzed Ice Wall is the only ice protecting Archives, and Archives is empty. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner plays Compile and runs Archives. On encountering Ice Wall the Runner searches the stack for Mayfly and installs it, ignoring all costs, then pays 1 credit to break Ice Wall's subroutine with Mayfly. The run goes on and ends.

steps.label: end
steps.do: Both 'when the run ends' abilities are pending. The Runner resolves Compile's first, then Mayfly's.

expect.why: Both abilities are the Runner's; the Runner picks the order.
Compile put it on the bottom of the stack. It is a new object there, so Mayfly's ability has nothing to trash.
Not a standard key: the title of the bottom card of the stack.
5, less 2 for Compile and 1 for the break.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner plays Compile and runs Archives, installs Mayfly from the stack on encountering Ice Wall and breaks the subroutine with it. The run goes on and ends.

steps.label: end
steps.do: The Runner resolves Mayfly's ability first, then Compile's.

expect.why: Mayfly's ability trashes it. Compile's program is then no longer installed, so Compile does nothing.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Mimic and Cyberfeeder are installed, and Cyberfeeder holds its 1 recurring credit. A rezzed Neural Katana is the only ice protecting HQ. The Runner has 5 credits and 3 cards in the grip.

steps.label: break
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Neural Katana and breaks its subroutine with Mimic, paying the 1 credit with the credit on Cyberfeeder.

expect.why: The cost came from Cyberfeeder, not the credit pool.
The subroutine was broken, so no net damage.
Not a standard key: whether the game treats the card as used. The Runner triggered Mimic's paid ability.
Not a standard key. Cyberfeeder's ability allowed the credit to be spent, so Cyberfeeder was used too.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Neural Katana is the only ice protecting HQ. The grip holds exactly 3 cards: I've Had Worse and two others with no abilities that matter. The stack holds at least 3 cards. The Corp's identity is blank. The Runner has no icebreaker.

steps.label: damage
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Neural Katana and breaks nothing. The subroutine does 3 net damage.

expect.why: All 3 cards are trashed. I've Had Worse's ability is active in the heap, so the Runner draws 3.

cases.position: As 9.1.8b.ex1, but the Corp's identity is Skorpios Defense Systems: Persuasive Power, which has not removed a card from the game this turn.

steps.label: damage
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Neural Katana and breaks nothing. The subroutine does 3 net damage. The Corp uses Skorpios Defense Systems to remove I've Had Worse from the game.

expect.why: I've Had Worse did not reach the heap, so its ability is not active and the Runner draws nothing.
Not a standard key: who has won the game. 3 damage against 3 cards is not more than the grip.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server with no ice has three cards in its root: a rezzed Hostile Infrastructure and two unrezzed upgrades, Tori Hanzō and AMAZE Amusements. The grip holds Singularity and 4 other cards. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: singularity
steps.do: The Runner plays Singularity, running that remote server. The run is successful and all three cards in the root are trashed at once. Hostile Infrastructure's ability resolves for each.

expect.why: 4 cards left after playing Singularity; 3 instances of Hostile Infrastructure's ability each do 1 net damage.
Singularity costs an additional click.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Test Run is in the grip and Nanuq is in the stack. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: play
steps.do: The Runner plays Test Run, searches the stack for Nanuq and installs it, ignoring all costs.

steps.label: turn-ends
steps.do: The Runner's turn ends. Test Run's delayed ability adds Nanuq to the top of the stack, and Nanuq's first ability resolves.

expect.why: Being added to the stack uninstalls Nanuq. Its 'when uninstalled' ability stays active in the stack until it resolves, and removes Nanuq from the game.

cases.position: Runner's turn. HQ has no ice and holds exactly one card, Archangel. Mimic is the Runner's only installed card. The Corp has 5 credits and the Runner has no link.

steps.label: access
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and accesses Archangel. The Corp pays 3 credits and the Runner encounters Archangel, breaking nothing. Neither player spends on the trace. The Corp chooses Mimic for the subroutine.

expect.why: Not a standard key: whether an encounter with Archangel took place.
The subroutine is active during the encounter although Archangel is not installed. Trace 6 against link 0 is successful.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Femme Fatale is installed, with Tollbooth as the ice chosen by its 'when installed' ability. A rezzed Tollbooth is the only ice protecting HQ. HQ holds exactly one card, Hedge Fund. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: encounter
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and encounters Tollbooth. The Runner triggers Femme Fatale's ability first and pays 1 credit to bypass Tollbooth.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: The run goes on, the Runner breaches HQ and the run ends.

expect.why: 1 credit for Tollbooth's one subroutine. Tollbooth's own ability lost its pending status when the encounter ended, so the 3 credits are not paid.

cases.skip: The example says which kinds of statement are restrictions (a definition of X, a limit on X). It names no card and gives no board position.

cases.position: Runner's turn. The Runner's identity is Zahya Sadeghi: Versatile Smuggler. HQ has no ice and holds exactly one card, Hedge Fund. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: first
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and accesses Hedge Fund. When the run ends the Runner chooses not to gain a credit from Zahya Sadeghi's ability.

steps.label: second
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ again, accesses Hedge Fund, and when the run ends gains 1 credit from Zahya Sadeghi's ability.

expect.why: Declining is not using the ability, so its once per turn limit is not spent.

steps.label: first
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, accesses Hedge Fund, and when the run ends gains 1 credit from Zahya Sadeghi's ability.

steps.label: second
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ again and accesses Hedge Fund. The run ends.

expect.why: The ability was used this turn.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Puffer is installed with 1 hosted power counter, and Gebrselassie is hosted on Puffer. A rezzed Neural Katana is the only ice protecting HQ, and HQ holds exactly one card, Hedge Fund. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: pump
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Neural Katana, pays 2 credits for +1 strength on Puffer, then pays 1 credit to break the subroutine.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: The run goes on, the Runner accesses Hedge Fund and the run ends.

steps.label: remove
steps.do: The Runner spends a click on Puffer's ability to remove its hosted power counter.

steps.label: turn-ends
steps.do: The Runner's turn ends.

expect.why: 2 printed, +1 for the power counter, +1 from the paid ability.
Gebrselassie makes the paid ability's increase last for the remainder of the turn.
The static ability's increase is not a lingering effect. It is lost at once with the counter; the paid increase stays.
The turn is over, so the paid increase has expired.

cases.position: Runner's turn. The Cleaners is in the Corp's score area. A rezzed Flare is the only ice protecting HQ. The Runner has Biometric Spoofing and Cyberfeeder installed (Cyberfeeder is the only hardware), 4 cards in the grip, no link and no icebreaker.

steps.label: flare
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Flare and breaks nothing. Neither player spends on the trace. The Corp trashes Cyberfeeder. The Runner tries to trash Biometric Spoofing to prevent the meat damage.

expect.why: The Cleaners' extra point keeps the 'cannot be prevented' of Flare's damage: all 3 meat damage are unpreventable.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Imp is installed with 2 virus counters. A remote server has a rezzed Wendigo (no advancement counters) as its only ice and a rezzed Mumbad Virtual Tour as the only card in its root. The Runner has 5 credits and no icebreaker.

steps.label: wendigo
steps.do: The Runner runs the remote server, encounters Wendigo and breaks nothing. The Corp chooses Imp for the subroutine.

steps.label: access
steps.do: The run goes on and the Runner accesses Mumbad Virtual Tour. The Runner tries to use Imp, and tries to leave the card untrashed.

expect.why: Imp's ability is optional and Wendigo forbids using Imp this run.
The Runner can pay the trash cost, so Mumbad Virtual Tour forces the basic trash ability.

cases.position: As 9.5.3a.ex1, but the Runner has 4 credits.

steps.label: wendigo
steps.do: The Runner runs the remote server, encounters Wendigo and breaks nothing. The Corp chooses Imp for the subroutine.

steps.label: access
steps.do: The run goes on and the Runner accesses Mumbad Virtual Tour. The Runner tries to use Imp.

expect.why: The Runner cannot pay 5 and cannot use Imp, so the card cannot be trashed at all.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Fermenter is installed with 4 hosted virus counters. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: use
steps.do: The Runner spends a click and trashes Fermenter to use its ability.

expect.why: 2 credits for each of the 4 counters set aside as the cost was paid.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Street Peddler is installed with three cards hosted on it facedown: Corroder, Mimic and Sure Gamble. The Runner has 5 credits and the heap is empty.

steps.label: use
steps.do: The Runner trashes Street Peddler to use its ability and installs Corroder.

expect.why: Corroder's install cost of 2, lowered by 1.
The two cards still set aside are trashed at the next checkpoint.

cases.position: Corp's turn, in the Corp's paid ability window before an action. A rezzed Reconstruction Contract with 2 hosted advancement counters is alone in a remote server. A rezzed Ice Wall with no counters protects HQ. The Corp has 5 credits.

steps.label: use
steps.do: The Corp trashes Reconstruction Contract to use its ability, chooses Ice Wall and moves both counters to it.

expect.why: The counters were set aside as the cost was paid and moved when the instruction resolved.
Not an action.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Project Wotan is in the Corp's score area with 3 agenda counters. A rezzed Ice Wall is the only ice protecting R&D. A rezzed Eli 1.0 is the only ice protecting HQ. The Runner has no icebreaker.

steps.label: idle
steps.do: Before any run, in a paid ability window, the Corp tries to use Project Wotan's ability.

steps.label: ice-wall
steps.do: The Runner runs R&D. While the Runner approaches Ice Wall the Corp tries to use Project Wotan's ability. The run then ends on Ice Wall's subroutine.

steps.label: eli
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ. While the Runner approaches Eli 1.0 the Corp uses Project Wotan's ability.

expect.why: No ice is being approached.
Ice Wall is not bioroid ice.
Not a standard key: the number of subroutines the ice has. Two printed, plus the 'End the run.' Project Wotan gives it for this run.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Arruaceiras Crew is installed. A rezzed Ice Wall with no counters is the only ice protecting HQ. The Runner has no tags.

steps.label: idle
steps.do: Before any run, in a paid ability window, the Runner tries to use Arruaceiras Crew's first ability.

steps.label: encounter
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Ice Wall and uses Arruaceiras Crew's first ability, taking 1 tag.

expect.why: The ability refers to the ice being encountered, so it can be used only during an encounter.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Abagnale (strength 2) is installed. A rezzed Ice Wall is the only ice protecting R&D. A rezzed Marker (a code gate of strength 3) is the only ice protecting HQ, and HQ holds exactly one card, Hedge Fund. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: barrier
steps.do: The Runner runs R&D and encounters Ice Wall. The Runner tries Abagnale's trash ability and its interface ability. The run ends on the subroutine.

steps.label: gate
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and encounters Marker. Without raising Abagnale's strength the Runner tries its interface ability, then trashes Abagnale to bypass Marker.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: The run goes on and ends.

expect.why: Ice Wall is not a code gate.
Abagnale's strength of 2 is less than Marker's 3.
The trash ability needs only an encounter with a code gate, not enough strength.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Hostile Infrastructure is alone in one remote server. A second remote server with no ice has three unrezzed cards in its root: PAD Campaign, Tori Hanzō and AMAZE Amusements. The grip holds Singularity and 4 other cards. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: singularity
steps.do: The Runner plays Singularity, running the second remote server. The run is successful and its three cards are trashed at once.

expect.why: Hostile Infrastructure's condition is met once for each of the 3 cards, so 3 instances each do 1 net damage to the 4 cards left in the grip.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Blackguard is installed and Satellite Uplink is in the grip. An unrezzed PAD Campaign is alone in a remote server and an unrezzed Ice Wall protects HQ. The Corp has 5 credits and the Runner 5.

steps.label: uplink
steps.do: The Runner plays Satellite Uplink and exposes PAD Campaign and Ice Wall. Blackguard's ability resolves for each.

expect.why: Two instances of Blackguard's ability, one per exposed card. The Corp can pay each rez cost, so it must.
5, less 2 for PAD Campaign and 1 for Ice Wall.

cards: Ob Superheavy Logistics: Extract. Export. Excel.
cases.position: The Corp's turn is about to begin. The Corp's identity is Ob Superheavy Logistics: Extract. Export. Excel. A rezzed Reaper Function is alone in a remote server. Nico Campaign is in R&D. The Corp has 5 credits. The Runner has 3 cards in the grip.

steps.label: turn-begins
steps.do: The Corp's turn begins. The Corp trashes Reaper Function to do 2 net damage, and uses Ob Superheavy Logistics to search R&D for Nico Campaign, then installs and rezzes it. The 'turn begins' abilities finish resolving.

expect.why: Nico Campaign became active after the 'turn begins' condition was processed, so the Corp takes no credits from it this turn.
Ob Superheavy Logistics ignores the rez cost, and nothing was taken from Nico Campaign.

cases.position: Corp's turn. Architect Deployment Test is installed in a remote server with 4 advancement counters. Tranquility Home Grid is the top card of R&D. HQ is empty and the Corp has 5 credits. The Corp has installed no card this turn.

steps.label: score
steps.do: The Corp scores Architect Deployment Test, looks at the top 5 cards of R&D, and installs Tranquility Home Grid in the root of a new remote server and rezzes it, ignoring all costs.

expect.why: Tranquility Home Grid was not active at the checkpoint that processed its own install, so its ability gives no 2 credits; the rez cost was ignored.
No card was drawn from Tranquility Home Grid either.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Quantum Predictive Model is installed faceup, alone in a remote server with no ice, with Casting Call hosted on it as a condition counter (the Corp played Casting Call on an earlier turn). The Runner has no tags.

steps.label: access
steps.do: The Runner runs the remote server and accesses Quantum Predictive Model. Casting Call's ability resolves. The Runner steals the agenda if able.

expect.why: From Casting Call.
The Runner was not tagged when the access began, so Quantum Predictive Model's ability never met its condition, in any order.

cases.position: The Runner's turn is about to begin. The Runner's identity is Armand "Geist" Walker (1 link). Underworld Contact is installed. The Supplier is installed with Dyson Mem Chip hosted on it. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: turn-begins
steps.do: The Runner's turn begins. The Runner triggers The Supplier first and installs Dyson Mem Chip, then Underworld Contact resolves.

expect.why: 5, less 1 for Dyson Mem Chip (3 lowered by 2), plus 1 from Underworld Contact, which checks for 2 link when it resolves.

steps.label: turn-begins
steps.do: The Runner's turn begins. The Runner triggers Underworld Contact first, then The Supplier, and installs Dyson Mem Chip.

expect.why: Underworld Contact resolved with only 1 link and gave nothing; then 1 credit for Dyson Mem Chip.

cases.position: Corp's turn. The Corp's identity is Weyland Consortium: Built to Last. A rezzed Ice Wall with no advancement counters protects HQ. The Corp has 5 credits.

steps.label: first
steps.do: The Corp takes the basic action to advance Ice Wall.

steps.label: second
steps.do: The Corp advances Ice Wall again.

expect.why: 1 paid to advance, 2 gained: the card had no counters at the checkpoint before the advancement.
The card had a counter this time.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Architect protects HQ with Parasite hosted on it, and Parasite has 3 virus counters, so Architect's strength is 0. The Runner has 5 credits. (The example's other half, an interrupt that prevents the trash, names no card and is not built.)

steps.label: click
steps.do: The Runner takes the basic action to gain 1 credit.

expect.why: Players cannot trash Architect, so Parasite's ability has no effect it can perform.
The ability resolves once per timing step and the game goes on.

cases.position: The Runner's turn is about to begin. Aesop's Pawnshop and Drug Dealer are installed. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: turn-begins
steps.do: The Runner's turn begins. The Runner triggers Aesop's Pawnshop first and trashes Drug Dealer with it.

expect.why: 3 from Aesop's Pawnshop. Drug Dealer's pending ability is gone with it, so no credit is lost.

steps.label: turn-begins
steps.do: The Runner's turn begins. The Runner triggers Drug Dealer first, then Aesop's Pawnshop, trashing Drug Dealer.

expect.why: 1 lost to Drug Dealer, then 3 gained.

cases.position: Runner's turn, no click spent. The grip holds In the Groove, Corroder, Mimic and Sacrificial Construct. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: groove
steps.do: The Runner plays In the Groove as the first click.

steps.label: first
steps.do: The Runner installs Corroder and chooses to gain 1 credit.

steps.label: second
steps.do: The Runner installs Mimic and chooses to gain 1 credit.

steps.label: zero
steps.do: The Runner installs Sacrificial Construct, whose printed install cost is 0.

expect.why: 5, less 2, plus 1.
The ability has a stated duration, so it resolves every time its condition is met this turn: 4, less 3, plus 1.
A printed install cost of 0 does not meet the condition.

cases.position: The Runner's turn is about to begin. Joshua B. is installed. The Runner has no tags and an empty grip.

steps.label: begin
steps.do: The Runner's turn begins and the Runner uses Joshua B. to gain a click.

steps.label: end
steps.do: The Runner spends every click gaining credits, and the turn ends.

steps.label: next-end
steps.do: The Corp takes its turn without affecting tags. The Runner's next turn begins; the Runner does not use Joshua B., spends every click gaining credits, and that turn ends.

expect.why: The delayed ability resolved once and expired. It does not give a tag at the end of a later turn.

cases.position: Corp's turn. Hostile Takeover is installed in a remote server with 2 advancement counters. HQ holds exactly one card, Chrysalis. The Runner has Gang Sign and Mayfly installed, 5 credits and 3 cards in the grip.

steps.label: encounter
steps.do: The Corp scores Hostile Takeover. Gang Sign makes the Runner breach HQ, outside any run, and the Runner accesses Chrysalis and encounters it. The Runner pays 1 credit to raise Mayfly's strength to 2 and 1 credit to break the subroutine. The encounter and the breach end.

steps.label: turn-ends
steps.do: The Corp's turn ends.

expect.why: The subroutine was broken.
No run was in progress, so the 'when this run ends' ability was never created and Mayfly is not trashed.

cases.position: Corp's turn. The Corp's score area holds AstroScript Pilot Program with 1 agenda counter and Market Research with none. 24/7 News Cycle is in HQ. The Runner has no tags.

steps.label: play
steps.do: The Corp plays 24/7 News Cycle, forfeiting Market Research, and resolves AstroScript Pilot Program's 'when scored' ability.

expect.why: A forfeited agenda is removed from the game.

cases.position: As 9.6.14d.ex1, but the Runner has 1 tag.

steps.label: play
steps.do: The Corp plays 24/7 News Cycle, forfeiting AstroScript Pilot Program, and resolves Market Research's 'when scored' ability.

expect.why: Market Research is worth 1 more point while it has an agenda counter.

cases.position: As 9.6.14d.ex1: the Runner has no tags.

steps.label: play
steps.do: The Corp plays 24/7 News Cycle, forfeiting AstroScript Pilot Program, and tries to resolve Market Research's 'when scored' ability.

expect.why: The rest of Market Research's condition (the Runner is tagged) is not met, so the ability cannot become pending.

cases.position: Corp's turn, no click spent. On the Runner's last turn the Runner trashed a Corp card (a PAD Campaign, accessed in a remote server). Oppo Research is in HQ. No player has agenda points. The Corp has 5 credits and the Runner has no tags.

steps.label: play
steps.do: The Corp plays Oppo Research.

expect.why: The third ability. The threat 3 ability is not active.
Not a standard key: whether the Corp's action phase has ended with clicks unspent. The second ability ends it after the operation resolves.

cases.position: Corp's turn, no click spent. On the Runner's last turn the Runner neither stole nor trashed a Corp card. Oppo Research is in HQ and the Corp has 5 credits.

steps.label: play
steps.do: The Corp tries to play Oppo Research.

expect.why: The first ability is a restriction on playing the card.

cases.position: As 9.7.1.ex1, but Global Food Initiative is in the Corp's score area (3 agenda points) and the Corp has 10 credits.

steps.label: play
steps.do: The Corp plays Oppo Research and pays 5 credits for the threat 3 ability.

expect.why: The two play abilities resolve in sequence.
10, less 2 to play and 5 for the threat ability.
Not a standard key: see 9.7.1.ex1.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Lancelot is the only ice protecting HQ, with Sub Boost hosted on it as a condition counter. HQ holds exactly one card, Merlin. The Runner has no installed cards and 4 cards in the grip.

steps.label: encounter
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and encounters Lancelot. The Corp reveals Merlin and places its 'Do 2 net damage.' subroutine last, after the 'End the run.' from Sub Boost. The Runner breaks nothing and the subroutines resolve.

expect.why: Before Lancelot's printed subroutine.
Between the printed subroutine and Sub Boost's 'End the run.'
'End the run.' resolves before the net damage, and no more subroutines resolve once the encounter ends.

steps.label: encounter
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and encounters Lancelot. The Corp reveals Merlin and places its 'Do 2 net damage.' subroutine first, before Lancelot's printed subroutine. The Runner breaks nothing and the subroutines resolve.

expect.why: The net damage resolves before the run ends.

cases.position: Runner's turn, the first encounter of the turn. A rezzed Loki is the only ice protecting HQ. A rezzed Tithe protects R&D. A rezzed Warden Fatuma is alone in a remote server. The Runner has Stick and Poke installed, no icebreaker, and 3 cards in the grip. The Corp has 5 credits.

steps.label: encounter
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and encounters Loki. Stick and Poke's ability resolves, then Loki's, and the Corp chooses Tithe. The Runner breaks nothing. For the last subroutine the Runner does not shuffle the grip into the stack.

expect.why: Not a standard key: for each of Loki's subroutines in order, the card it came from, read once every ability at the start of the encounter has resolved. Among the 'before its other subroutines' ones the most recently added come first, then the printed one.
3, less 1 (Tithe), less 1 and plus 1 (Stick and Poke).
3 after the run action, less 1 for Warden Fatuma's subroutine.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Ashigaru is the only ice protecting HQ and a rezzed Panic Button is in the root of HQ. HQ holds 3 cards and R&D at least 1. The Runner has Corroder and Gbahali installed and 5 credits. The Corp has 5 credits.

steps.label: break3
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Ashigaru, pays 2 credits to raise Corroder's strength to 4 and 3 credits to break all three subroutines.

steps.label: panic
steps.do: In the same paid ability window the Corp pays 1 credit to draw a card with Panic Button.

steps.label: gbahali
steps.do: The Runner trashes Gbahali to break the last subroutine on Ashigaru.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: The run goes on and ends.

expect.why: Not a standard key: the number of unbroken subroutines on the ice in this encounter.
Not a standard key: the number of subroutines the ice has.
The new subroutine is added after the other three and comes into existence unbroken.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Ashigaru is the only ice protecting HQ. HQ holds 3 cards. The Runner has Corroder and Utopia Shard installed and 5 credits.

steps.label: break1
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Ashigaru, pays 2 credits to raise Corroder's strength to 4 and 1 credit to break the first subroutine.

steps.label: shard

cases.position: Runner's turn. False Echo is installed. An unrezzed Archer is the only ice protecting HQ. Hostile Takeover is in the Corp's score area. The Corp has 5 credits.

steps.label: pass
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ; the Corp does not rez Archer as it is approached. The Runner passes Archer and trashes False Echo. The Corp tries to rez Archer without forfeiting an agenda, then rezzes it, paying 4 credits and forfeiting Hostile Takeover.

expect.why: The Corp cannot dodge both options by declining the additional cost of one.

steps.label: pass
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ; the Corp does not rez Archer as it is approached. The Runner passes Archer and trashes False Echo. The Corp adds Archer to HQ.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server with no ice has a rezzed AMAZE Amusements and an unrezzed Hostile Takeover in its root. HQ has no ice and holds exactly one card, Market Research. Doppelgänger is installed and unused this turn. The Runner has 5 credits and no tags.

steps.label: first-run
steps.do: The Runner runs the remote server, accesses AMAZE Amusements and pays 3 credits to trash it, then accesses and steals Hostile Takeover. The run ends.

steps.label: second-run
steps.do: With AMAZE Amusements' ability still pending, the Runner triggers Doppelgänger first and runs HQ, steals Market Research, and that run ends.

steps.label: resolved
steps.do: The pending abilities from the end of the first run finish resolving.

expect.why: The instance pending from the first run still resolves. No second instance is created for the second run, though an agenda was stolen during it.
